name: Codex worker spawn reproduction

tasks.description: Write the probe script verbatim from human plan Task 1 Step 1 to the scratchpad (bare `codex` as daemon; logs tmux global PATH + both codex resolutions + before/after codex process listing; readiness mirrors _wait_for_ready; 300 s id-file poll where ID_* counts only pane-tree writers and ANY_* records first writer of any provenance; rescan after each dispatch Enter, after one plain prompt, and before kill; logs config.toml rows). Disclosed side effects: config.toml trust/hooks rows, session-init global maintenance, ironclaude.db session rows. No tests required: investigation, no product code.
